title: Asset navigator detail panel configuration
description: Which fields the asset navigator's hover detail panel shows, per managed-object type. Stored as `detailPanel` inside the user's asset navigator settings (customProperties.ps_AssetNavigatorSettings, or the ps_AssetNavigatorSettings managed object for SSO users). A type listed in `types` uses its own list (an empty list shows no fields); any other leaf asset uses `default`; a branch asset always shows its subtree counts and only adds `types[type]`.

version.description: Contract version. Any other value is ignored and the defaults apply.

types.description: Field lists keyed by the managed object's `type` (e.g. `c8y_Linux`, `building`).

default.description: Fields of every leaf asset whose type has no entry in `types`.

unit.description: Appended to the value. For measurements the reading's own unit is the fallback.

format.description: How the value is rendered. Default `text`; `percent` appends `%`; `date` renders an ISO timestamp in the user's locale.

oneOf.description: A dot path into the managed object, e.g. `c8y_Hardware.model`. Read from the cached inventory, no request.
The latest value of a measurement series `<fragment>.<series>` (from `c8y_LatestMeasurements`, one request per asset).
Built-in values: `alarms` (active alarms of the asset and its subtree by severity), `availability` (c8y_Availability in words), `lastUpdated`, `type`.
